notes.title: First trailer and Merry Christmas
notes.notes:
After many months of work and development I come to bring you a small trailer of the game, it is not finished yet so many of the things you see may change in the future. I only ask that you put the game on your Wish List as that helps me a lot to continue progressing. Thank you all very much for your support and happy holidays again. I leave you with the trailer.
